speaker: Peris
text: Where...? What is this place?
context: Peris wakes in the elevator

text: A small room. Metal walls. Red emergency light cycling overhead. Two white figures against the far wall, dormant. Someone slumped in the corner.
context: Scene description

speaker: Peris
text: Hey. Hey, can you hear me? Are you alive? Please be alive.
context: Peris approaches Aster

speaker: Aster
text: ...I already submitted the forecast. Check the terminal.
context: Aster wakes groggy — still in the simulation mentally

speaker: Aster
text: ...This isn't the sim. Where are we?
context: Aster realizes

speaker: Aster
text: My device is locked. No facility access. No maintenance overlay.
context: Aster checks device first thing

speaker: Peris
text: Doors won't respond. I tried.
context: Peris confirms they're stuck

speaker: Peris
text: Why are we here?

speaker: Aster
text: Tag Day. A citizen's scan failed and they walked him to the Wellness Wing.
context: Aster retells it flatly — doesn't know what happened

speaker: Aster
text: He was reciting something on the way. I couldn't make it out. Then the checkpoint reset.
context: No mention of the bang — Aster's data view couldn't see the room

speaker: Peris
text: Is he OK?

speaker: Aster
text: I... never thought to ask. It wasn't really any of my business. There's a privacy policy.
context: Cites the policy like it settles the matter

speaker: Peris
text: Speaking of policy...
context: Pivots — policy is also what happened to her

speaker: Peris
text: Have you ever performed so poorly they started showing you animations of soap being cut and gel being squished? It's the most uncomfortable comfort I've ever felt.
context: Peris disturbed by how soothing it was meant to be

speaker: Aster
text: Poorly? I've only performed so well that they give me perks, like this upgraded device...
context: Oblivious flex — interrupted by system restoration

speaker: SYSTEM
text: MAINTENANCE CYCLE COMPLETE  //  DEVICE ACCESS RESTORED  //  RESUMING PASSENGER PROTOCOL
context: System restores devices and wakes escorts simultaneously

speaker: Aster
text: My device. It's back. There's a maintenance panel behind the doors.
context: Aster's data overlay reveals the panel

speaker: EU-1
text: PASSENGERS CONSCIOUS  //  DISTRESS DETECTED  //  INITIATING RE-SEDATION PROTOCOL
context: Escort units activate as part of the same restoration

speaker: Aster
text: No no no. My device. I can pulse it, fry their circuits.
context: Aster panicking but finding a solution

speaker: Aster
text: They'll reboot. We don't have long. That panel. Now.
context: Post-EMP urgency

speaker: Aster
text: I can override this. Just need a moment...
context: Aster begins hacking the panel

speaker: SYSTEM
text: MAINTENANCE OVERRIDE ACCEPTED  //  DOORS CYCLING
context: Hack succeeds

text: The elevator shudders. The doors grind open. Light spills in from a corridor neither of them recognizes.
context: Doors open

speaker: SYSTEM
text: TAG STATUS: NON-COMPLIANT  //  WELLNESS PROTOCOL DEVIATION
context: Notification Aster dismisses — not a lockout yet

speaker: Aster
text: Administrative error. I'll sort it out when we get back.
context: Aster doesn't understand what non-compliant means yet

speaker: Peris
text: I don't really have anything to go back to, anyways...

speaker: Aster
text: Forward then.

speaker: Peris
text: I don't think we're supposed to be here.
context: Entering the maintenance corridor

speaker: Aster
text: Nobody is. This section hasn't been serviced in... the maintenance logs just stop.
context: Aster reads corridor data

text: An elevated walkway spanning a larger space. Incomplete railing. Exposed framework. The air is open — it smells like rust.
context: Bridge description

speaker: Peris
text: Those people down there...
context: Peris sees bodies below the bridge

speaker: Aster
text: All casualties are supposed to be logged. I'll check the records when we find a working terminal. Come on.
context: Aster files it as data and keeps moving

speaker: Aster
text: There's something ahead. Lights.
context: Waits for click — bridge collapse follows

speaker: Peris
text: The floor—!
context: Bridge gives way

speaker: Peris
text: Are you hurt?
context: After the fall

speaker: Aster
text: Sub-level. We fell through.
context: Aster reads the environment

speaker: Aster
text: They might have called me a beast, but I'm not this type of animal...
context: Looking up at the collapsed bridge — no way back up

speaker: Peris
text: We've got the combined strength of two children. It wouldn't be physically possible to climb this...

speaker: Aster
text: There's something over there. Another way forward.
context: Finds the alternative path (TBD)

speaker: Aster
text: Two corridors. One's clear but corroded. The other's shorter, but something's in there.
context: Aster reads the fork — safe route has iron hazards on floor; dangerous route has hostiles

text: The light is changing. Dimming.
context: Scripted dusk — first nightfall approaching

speaker: Aster
text: Sealant applicators. Pressure readers. Manual torque adjusters. No automated systems. Whoever lives here is maintaining this entire section by hand.
context: Aster examines the workbench

speaker: Peris
text: These are all laid out so carefully. Every tool in its place. Someone really cares about their work.
context: Peris examines the workbench

speaker: Aster
text: Barrier integrity readings. Trending downward. Slowly, but consistently. Whoever is logging this has been watching the wall weaken for years.
context: Aster reads the monitoring station

speaker: Peris
text: All these little gauges. I don't know what they measure but they all look like they're... leaning the wrong way.
context: Peris reads the monitoring station

speaker: Aster
text: Consuming food you do not own is a breach of protocol.
context: Aster at the food cache — compliance over survival

speaker: Peris
text: It's not very nice to take someone else's food!
context: Peris at the food cache — empathy over survival

speaker: Aster
text: Significant wear pattern on the floor here. Someone stands in this exact spot regularly. The window faces the bridge approach.
context: Aster at the lookout spot

speaker: Peris
text: Someone stands here a lot. Looking out. Waiting for someone.
context: Peris at the lookout spot

speaker: Aster
text: This heating element is active and positioned at the entrance. Inefficient placement for personal use. It's oriented outward.
context: Aster at the heater — data without emotional inference

speaker: Peris
text: This is warm. It's been running for a while. Someone set it up for visitors.
context: Peris at the heater — she reads the care

speaker: Aster
text: What annotation format is this? This is definitely not standard!
context: Aster at the wall markings — unrecognized system

speaker: Peris
text: I'm not sure what these markings say, but the handwriting's got a lot of personality.
context: Peris at the wall markings — she reads the person

speaker: Aster
text: Who has time to waste on things like these?
context: Aster at the puzzle game — can't fathom leisure

speaker: Peris
text: Oh, it's a little puzzle. Someone made this by hand. It's been used a lot, look how smooth the edges are.
context: Peris at the puzzle game — she sees the care and the loneliness

text: Someone in the doorway. Beckoning.
context: Endo gestures them inside — marker appears on shelter

speaker: Peris
text: Who...?

speaker: Aster
text: Endosomal unit. Non-hostile. His tag reads compliant, but the signal's dead.
context: Aster scans Endo

text: He holds out a container. Points at it, then at them.
context: Endo offers drink — marker on container

speaker: Peris
text: Can't sleep well on an empty stomach.
context: Accepts the drink

text: He moves to the window. Settles against the wall, watching outward.
context: Endo takes watch — no marker needed

text: Red. Through the grating. Watching.
context: Pairs of eyes outside — the player sees them too

text: Morning. They're gone.
context: The eyes recede with the light

text: A faint wet trail near the shelter door, already drying. It wasn't there last night.
context: Evidence of the night visitors

speaker: Aster
text: It's not letting me back in.
context: Aster tries his device — locked out of the simulation

speaker: Peris
text: ...Back in to what?
context: Not rhetorical — what exactly does he want to go back to

text: He stands. Looks at the corridor ahead, then at them. Steps toward the door.
context: Endo gestures: he's coming with

speaker: Peris
text: I think he's coming with us.

speaker: Aster
text: I don't see why not.

speaker: Aster
text: Dense cluster ahead. Five, maybe six. Too many to push through.
context: Aster reads the gauntlet

speaker: Peris
text: There's something on the wall. Iron lure — ferrolure. If I activate it, they might go for that instead.
context: Peris recognizes the device

text: FERROLURE ACTIVE  //  SIDEROPHORE LURE  //  18s REMAINING
context: System readout
